title: PrecipJEPA: JEPA-Regularized Future-State Prediction with Motion-Source Rendering for Precipitation Nowcasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.38926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term precipitation nowcasting requires modeling radar-echo evolution while preserving localized high-intensity structures. Recent radar-specific studies motivate location-aware prediction and separating echo displacement from intensity change. However existing encoders learn historical representations mainly from final forecast errors. We propose PrecipJEPA, which couples a structured forecasting path with an auxiliary path that enriches its encoder from observed radar history. In the forecasting path, an online encoder first converts the observations into spatiotemporal tokens. The Task-Driven Future-State Predictor (TFP) combines these tokens with a recent-dynamics summary and spatiotemporal queries to construct future radar states. translated_title: PrecipJEPA：基于JEPA正则化的未来状态预测与运动-源渲染的降水临近预报方法
translated_abstract: 长期降水临近预报需要对雷达回波演化进行建模，同时保持局部高强度结构。近期针对雷达的研究推动了位置感知预测以及将回波位移与强度变化相分离的方法。然而，现有编码器主要从最终预测误差中学习历史表征。我们提出PrecipJEPA，它将一条结构化预测路径与一条从观测雷达历史中丰富编码器的辅助路径相耦合。在预测路径中，在线编码器首先将观测转化为时空token；任务驱动的未来状态预测器（TFP）将这些token与近期动态摘要和时空查询相结合，构建未来雷达状态；并行运动-源渲染器（PMSR）将这些状态解码为运动场和源-汇场，从而将最新观测转换为未来帧。在联合训练过程中，历史掩码……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出PrecipJEPA框架，通过JEPA正则化的辅助路径从观测雷达历史中学习编码器表征，并利用任务驱动的未来状态预测器与并行运动-源渲染器将回波位移与强度变化解耦，从而在长期降水临近预报中更好地保持局部高强度结构。
en_tdlr: PrecipJEPA couples a structured forecasting path with a JEPA-regularized auxiliary path that learns encoder representations from observed radar history, using task-driven future-state prediction and parallel motion-source rendering to decouple echo displacement from intensity change for improved long-term precipitation nowcasting.
